playbook-health-baseline-check.md.detail_zh: 建立系统健康基线，适合交接、验收和维修前留档
playbook-health-baseline-check.md.detail_en: Comprehensive device health check — disk, memory, uptime, updates, firewall, backup, and network
playbook-health-baseline-check.md.triggers_zh: 全面体检、设备健康、交接前检查
playbook-health-baseline-check.md.prompt_zh: 帮我给这台电脑做一次全面体检，先只读并输出报告。
playbook-health-baseline-check.md.prompt_en: Run a full health check on this machine — read-only first, then give me a report.
playbook-health-baseline-check.md.when_en: New device setup, periodic health audit, pre-migration baseline, user reports general slowness, or "just check everything is OK."

playbook-performance-forensics.md.detail_zh: CPU、内存压力、IO、风扇和无响应
playbook-performance-forensics.md.detail_en: Diagnose slowness, high CPU, memory pressure, and hangs
playbook-performance-forensics.md.triggers_zh: 高 CPU、内存压力、卡顿、风扇、无响应
playbook-performance-forensics.md.prompt_zh: Mac 风扇一直转，帮我判断是 CPU、内存还是磁盘 IO。
playbook-performance-forensics.md.prompt_en: My Mac's fans never stop — tell me whether it is CPU, memory or disk I/O.
playbook-performance-forensics.md.when_en: User reports: computer is slow, fans are loud, spinning beach ball, apps freezing, system lagging, "everything takes forever."

playbook-windows-performance-forensics.m.detail_zh: CPU、内存、磁盘瓶颈、启动慢和应用无响应
playbook-windows-performance-forensics.m.detail_en: Diagnose Windows slowness, CPU saturation, memory pressure, disk bottlenecks, startup load, and application hangs
playbook-windows-performance-forensics.m.triggers_zh: 高 CPU、内存压力、磁盘瓶颈、启动慢、应用无响应
playbook-windows-performance-forensics.m.prompt_zh: Windows 很卡，先找出最占 CPU、内存和磁盘的进程。
playbook-windows-performance-forensics.m.prompt_en: Windows is sluggish — first find the processes using the most CPU, memory and disk.
playbook-windows-performance-forensics.m.when_en: User reports a slow Windows machine, high CPU, low memory, heavy disk use, fan noise, freezes, delayed startup, or an unresponsive application.

playbook-linux-performance-forensics.md.detail_zh: 负载、CPU、内存、交换、IO 等待和容器限额
playbook-linux-performance-forensics.md.detail_en: Diagnose Linux load, CPU, memory pressure, swapping, IO waits, disk bottlenecks, cgroup limits, and process hangs
playbook-linux-performance-forensics.md.triggers_zh: 高负载、CPU 饱和、内存压力、交换、IO 等待、容器限额
playbook-linux-performance-forensics.md.prompt_zh: 服务器负载很高，区分是 CPU 饱和、IO 等待还是容器限额。
playbook-linux-performance-forensics.md.prompt_en: Server load is high — separate CPU saturation from I/O wait and container limits.
playbook-linux-performance-forensics.md.when_en: User reports a slow Linux host, high load, CPU saturation, memory pressure, swapping, IO waits, container throttling, service latency, or process hangs.

playbook-mac-tune-up.md.detail_zh: 缓存、权限和基础安全维护
playbook-mac-tune-up.md.detail_en: Safe maintenance sweep for a generally-sluggish Mac — refresh caches and reclaim memory without risk
playbook-mac-tune-up.md.triggers_zh: Mac 普遍变慢、安全维护、缓存刷新
playbook-mac-tune-up.md.prompt_zh: Mac 变慢了，先做低风险维护，不要删我的个人文件。
playbook-mac-tune-up.md.prompt_en: My Mac got slow. Do low-risk maintenance only, and do not delete my personal files.
playbook-mac-tune-up.md.when_en: - User asks to "tune up", "optimize", "speed up", or "clean up" their Mac in

playbook-disk-space-recovery.md.detail_zh: 大文件、缓存和可释放空间审计
playbook-disk-space-recovery.md.detail_en: Reclaim disk space on macOS — measure, audit, clean cache-class data, report freed bytes
playbook-disk-space-recovery.md.triggers_zh: 磁盘爆满、释放空间、大文件与缓存审计
playbook-disk-space-recovery.md.prompt_zh: Mac 磁盘快满了，先列出可以安全释放的空间。
playbook-disk-space-recovery.md.prompt_en: My Mac disk is nearly full — list what can be safely freed first.
playbook-disk-space-recovery.md.when_en: Explicit: "clean up my storage", "free disk space", "find space hogs", "check storage", "storage almost full", "low storage", "can't install update". Symptom-driven: Mac feels slow AND free space is below the healthy target.

playbook-windows-disk-space-recovery.md.detail_zh: 系统盘爆满、更新空间不足和安全释放
playbook-windows-disk-space-recovery.md.detail_en: Reclaim Windows disk space by measuring volumes, preserving user data, and verifying freed space
playbook-windows-disk-space-recovery.md.triggers_zh: 系统盘爆满、更新空间不足、安全释放空间
playbook-windows-disk-space-recovery.md.prompt_zh: C 盘快满了，先按风险分级给出清理计划。
playbook-windows-disk-space-recovery.md.prompt_en: My C: drive is nearly full — give me a cleanup plan ranked by risk.
playbook-windows-disk-space-recovery.md.when_en: User reports a full Windows drive, low-space warnings, update failures caused by storage, or asks to reclaim space without losing personal data.

playbook-windows-storage-inventory.md.detail_zh: 按路径和大小解释空间分配
playbook-windows-storage-inventory.md.detail_en: Build a privacy-preserving Windows storage inventory that explains large paths before any cleanup
playbook-windows-storage-inventory.md.triggers_zh: 大目录盘点、陌生路径、清理前空间分布
playbook-windows-storage-inventory.md.prompt_zh: 帮我找出 C 盘最大的目录，但不要删除任何东西。
playbook-windows-storage-inventory.md.prompt_en: Find the largest directories on C:, but do not delete anything.
playbook-windows-storage-inventory.md.when_en: Use when a Windows volume is unexpectedly full, an unfamiliar directory is large, or the user wants a map of storage before deciding what to remove.

playbook-windows-large-folder-management.detail_zh: 懒加载系统/应用数据/自定义目录和安全 offload
playbook-windows-large-folder-management.detail_en: Discover, lazily size, and safely offload selected Windows system or application folders
playbook-windows-large-folder-management.triggers_zh: 懒加载大文件夹、应用数据模板、自定义目录和安全 offload
playbook-windows-large-folder-management.prompt_zh: 先异步统计几个大文件夹，确认后把指定应用数据迁移到 D 盘。
playbook-windows-large-folder-management.prompt_en: Size several large folders asynchronously, then move approved application data to D:.
playbook-windows-large-folder-management.when_en: Use when the user wants to find large Windows folders, inspect application-data locations, or move a selected folder to another local volume.

playbook-windows-application-migration.m.detail_zh: 复制校验后用 Junction 保留原路径，支持回滚
playbook-windows-application-migration.m.detail_en: Migrate an application or selected data folder to local NTFS storage with junction rollback
playbook-windows-application-migration.m.triggers_zh: 应用或选定数据目录迁移到本地 NTFS 磁盘并保留原路径
playbook-windows-application-migration.m.prompt_zh: 把这个应用迁移到 D 盘，先检查 NTFS、空间、进程占用和恢复方案。
playbook-windows-application-migration.m.prompt_en: Move this application to D:; check NTFS, space, locks and the recovery plan first.
playbook-windows-application-migration.m.when_en: Use when the user wants to move an installed application, selected application data, or a custom folder while preserving the original path.

playbook-windows-migration-history-recov.detail_zh: 检查 Junction、幽灵记录并安全还原
playbook-windows-migration-history-recov.detail_en: Audit Windows migration Junctions, detect ghost records, and restore data safely
playbook-windows-migration-history-recov.triggers_zh: Junction 健康、幽灵链接、迁移历史审计和恢复
playbook-windows-migration-history-recov.prompt_zh: 这个软件迁移后打不开，先检查链接状态，不要覆盖原目录。
playbook-windows-migration-history-recov.prompt_en: This app stopped opening after migration; check the link without overwriting the original directory.
playbook-windows-migration-history-recov.when_en: Use when a migrated application or folder no longer opens, a Junction may be broken, or data must be restored to its original path.

playbook-windows-application-cleanup.md.detail_zh: 微信重复文件、浏览器缓存和包缓存
playbook-windows-application-cleanup.md.detail_en: Audit and clean regenerable Windows app caches or duplicates while preserving profiles, chat data, and credentials
playbook-windows-application-cleanup.md.triggers_zh: 应用缓存、微信重复文件、浏览器或包缓存
playbook-windows-application-cleanup.md.prompt_zh: 帮我清理微信重复文件，聊天记录和原文件不能动。
playbook-windows-application-cleanup.md.prompt_en: Clean up duplicate WeChat files; chat history and the originals must stay untouched.
playbook-windows-application-cleanup.md.when_en: Use for a named application's cache growth, WeChat received-file duplication, browser cache growth, package caches, or a request to reclaim application storage safely.

playbook-windows-application-lifecycle-a.title_zh: Windows 应用生命周期审计
playbook-windows-application-lifecycle-a.detail_en: Audit Windows app install/uninstall candidates by exact package ID, publisher, source, and reversible verification
playbook-windows-application-lifecycle-a.triggers_zh: 应用安装/卸载、WinGet/Chocolatey/Appx、残留审计
playbook-windows-application-lifecycle-a.prompt_zh: 审计这台电脑装了什么应用，先不要卸载。
playbook-windows-application-lifecycle-a.prompt_en: Audit what apps are installed on this machine — do not uninstall anything yet.
playbook-windows-application-lifecycle-a.when_en: Use when the user wants to remove bloatware, review installed applications,

playbook-windows-new-device-intake.md.detail_zh: 本地硬件、序列号、配置、开箱证据和首次设置
playbook-windows-new-device-intake.md.detail_en: Inspect a new Windows computer, preserve unboxing evidence, verify support/warranty, and establish a safe baseline
playbook-windows-new-device-intake.md.triggers_zh: 新机验机、官方支持、保修证据和首次设置
playbook-windows-new-device-intake.md.prompt_zh: 先做新机本地验收，不联网激活；查保修前先问我。
playbook-windows-new-device-intake.md.prompt_en: Do the local intake check on this new machine offline, no activation; ask me before any warranty lookup.
playbook-windows-new-device-intake.md.when_en: Use for a new laptop or desktop unboxing, acceptance check, return or warranty decision, first-time setup, suspected wrong specification, or a repair request on a recently purchased device.

playbook-linux-disk-space-recovery.md.detail_zh: 文件系统、inode、日志和容器存储增长
playbook-linux-disk-space-recovery.md.detail_en: Reclaim Linux disk space and inodes by measuring filesystems, cleaning native caches, and verifying services
playbook-linux-disk-space-recovery.md.triggers_zh: 文件系统或 inode 用尽、日志与容器存储增长
playbook-linux-disk-space-recovery.md.prompt_zh: Linux 根分区满了，先判断是 inode、日志还是容器占用。
playbook-linux-disk-space-recovery.md.prompt_en: The Linux root partition is full — is it inodes, logs or containers?
playbook-linux-disk-space-recovery.md.when_en: User reports a full filesystem, inode exhaustion, package/update failures, runaway logs, container storage growth, or asks to reclaim Linux disk space safely.

playbook-local-data-audit.md.detail_zh: 离职、设备回收前盘点敏感数据
playbook-local-data-audit.md.detail_en: Audit a device for locally stored sensitive or company data — for offboarding or device reassignment
playbook-local-data-audit.md.triggers_zh: 离职、设备回收、本地敏感数据盘点
playbook-local-data-audit.md.prompt_zh: 这台电脑要回收，先盘点敏感数据和残留账号，不要删除。
playbook-local-data-audit.md.prompt_en: This machine is being recycled — inventory sensitive data and leftover accounts, delete nothing.
playbook-local-data-audit.md.when_en: Employee offboarding, device reassignment, compliance audit, or when verifying that company data has been properly backed up before a wipe.

playbook-backup-verify-restore.md.detail_zh: 时间戳、完整性、可读性和独立目标恢复
playbook-backup-verify-restore.md.detail_en: Verify backup integrity by checking status, timestamps, and testing a real file restore
playbook-backup-verify-restore.md.triggers_zh: 验证备份、检查时间戳、抽样恢复文件
playbook-backup-verify-restore.md.prompt_zh: 验证备份能不能恢复一个测试文件，不要覆盖现有数据。
playbook-backup-verify-restore.md.prompt_en: Verify the backup can restore one test file, without overwriting existing data.
playbook-backup-verify-restore.md.when_en: Periodic backup verification, after setting up a new backup, compliance audit, or when the admin wants to confirm RPO/RTO for a device.

playbook-setup-backup.md.detail_zh: Time Machine 和基础备份策略
playbook-setup-backup.md.detail_en: Set up Time Machine backup on macOS or configure basic backup strategy
playbook-setup-backup.md.triggers_zh: 配置 Time Machine 或基础备份策略
playbook-setup-backup.md.prompt_zh: 帮我规划 Mac 的自动备份，先检查现有磁盘和空间。
playbook-setup-backup.md.prompt_en: Plan automatic backups for my Mac — check the existing disks and free space first.
playbook-setup-backup.md.when_en: User wants to set up backups, configure Time Machine, asks about data protection, or says they're worried about losing files.

playbook-network-diagnostics.md.detail_zh: Wi-Fi、地址、路由、DNS 和网页访问
playbook-network-diagnostics.md.detail_en: Systematic connectivity troubleshooting for Wi-Fi, DNS, and internet issues
playbook-network-diagnostics.md.triggers_zh: 无网络、Wi-Fi 掉线、DNS、网页打不开
playbook-network-diagnostics.md.prompt_zh: Mac 能连 Wi-Fi 但打不开网页，按层排查。
playbook-network-diagnostics.md.prompt_en: My Mac joins Wi-Fi but pages will not load — troubleshoot layer by layer.
playbook-network-diagnostics.md.when_en: User reports: can't connect, Wi-Fi dropping, slow internet, DNS errors, pages not loading, "no internet" warning.

playbook-windows-network-diagnostics.md.detail_zh: 网卡、DHCP、路由、DNS、代理、VPN 和 HTTP
playbook-windows-network-diagnostics.md.detail_en: Systematic Windows connectivity troubleshooting for adapters, DHCP, routes, DNS, proxy, VPN, and HTTP
playbook-windows-network-diagnostics.md.triggers_zh: 网卡、DHCP、路由、DNS、代理、VPN 或 HTTP 异常
playbook-windows-network-diagnostics.md.prompt_zh: Windows 只有部分网站打不开，先区分 DNS、代理还是路由。
playbook-windows-network-diagnostics.md.prompt_en: Only some sites fail on Windows — first tell me if it is DNS, proxy or routing.
playbook-windows-network-diagnostics.md.when_en: User reports no internet, limited connectivity, DNS failures, Wi-Fi or Ethernet drops, VPN side effects, proxy errors, or one service not loading on Windows.

playbook-linux-network-diagnostics.md.detail_zh: 链路、地址、路由、DNS、防火墙和命名空间
playbook-linux-network-diagnostics.md.detail_en: Systematic Linux connectivity troubleshooting for links, addresses, routes, DNS, HTTP, firewall, and namespaces
playbook-linux-network-diagnostics.md.triggers_zh: 链路、地址、路由、DNS、防火墙、命名空间异常
playbook-linux-network-diagnostics.md.prompt_zh: 容器不能联网，先检查宿主和容器的网络边界。
playbook-linux-network-diagnostics.md.prompt_en: The container has no network — check the host and container network boundary first.
playbook-linux-network-diagnostics.md.when_en: User reports no connectivity, DNS failure, intermittent network, service reachability problems, VPN side effects, or container versus host networking differences on Linux.

playbook-vpn-troubleshooting.md.detail_zh: 连接、掉线、分流和 DNS 异常
playbook-vpn-troubleshooting.md.detail_en: Diagnose VPN connection failures, drops, and split-tunnel DNS issues
playbook-vpn-troubleshooting.md.triggers_zh: VPN 连不上、掉线、分流 DNS 异常
playbook-vpn-troubleshooting.md.prompt_zh: VPN 能连接但内网域名打不开，先查分流和 DNS。
playbook-vpn-troubleshooting.md.prompt_en: The VPN connects but internal domains do not resolve — check split tunneling and DNS.
playbook-vpn-troubleshooting.md.when_en: User reports: VPN won't connect, VPN keeps disconnecting, can't access work resources on VPN, slow internet with VPN, DNS not resolving with VPN on.

playbook-dns-record-check.md.detail_en: Check email-related DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) for a domain
playbook-dns-record-check.md.prompt_zh: 检查 example.com 的 MX 和 SPF，告诉我哪些记录缺失。
playbook-dns-record-check.md.prompt_en: Check the MX and SPF records for example.com and tell me which ones are missing.
playbook-dns-record-check.md.when_en: Email delivery issues (bounces, going to spam), setting up a new email domain, migrating email providers, or verifying DNS configuration after changes.

playbook-email-connectivity-test.md.detail_en: Test network connectivity to email servers — SMTP, IMAP, POP3, and major providers
playbook-email-connectivity-test.md.triggers_zh: SMTP、IMAP、POP3 或邮件服务器连通性
playbook-email-connectivity-test.md.prompt_zh: 只测试邮件服务器端口和 TLS，不要发送真实邮件。
playbook-email-connectivity-test.md.prompt_en: Only test the mail server ports and TLS — do not send a real message.
playbook-email-connectivity-test.md.when_en: User can't send or receive email, email client shows connection errors, suspected firewall or network blocking email ports, or verifying connectivity after network changes.

playbook-identity-provider-test.md.detail_zh: Entra ID、Google Workspace 和 SSO 端点
playbook-identity-provider-test.md.detail_en: Test connectivity to identity providers — Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, and SSO endpoints
playbook-identity-provider-test.md.triggers_zh: Entra ID、Google Workspace、SSO 登录端点
playbook-identity-provider-test.md.prompt_zh: SSO 登录失败，先测试端点和时间/证书问题。
playbook-identity-provider-test.md.prompt_en: SSO login fails — test the endpoints plus clock and certificate issues.
playbook-identity-provider-test.md.when_en: User can't sign in to corporate services, SSO failures, "session expired" loops, MFA not working, or diagnosing whether the problem is network vs. account vs. IdP outage.

playbook-setup-wifi-profile.md.detail_zh: 家庭或企业 WPA2/WPA3 配置
playbook-setup-wifi-profile.md.detail_en: Connect to a new Wi-Fi network including enterprise/WPA2-Enterprise networks
playbook-setup-wifi-profile.md.prompt_zh: 配置企业 Wi-Fi；密码不要出现在输出和日志里。
playbook-setup-wifi-profile.md.prompt_en: Set up the enterprise Wi-Fi; the password must not appear in output or logs.
playbook-setup-wifi-profile.md.when_en: User needs to connect to Wi-Fi, join a corporate network, enter Wi-Fi credentials, or set up WPA2-Enterprise / 802.1x.

playbook-setup-email-account.md.detail_zh: Apple Mail 或 Outlook 添加邮箱
playbook-setup-email-account.md.detail_en: Add an email account to Apple Mail or Outlook on macOS
playbook-setup-email-account.md.triggers_zh: Apple Mail 或 Outlook 添加邮箱
playbook-setup-email-account.md.prompt_zh: 帮我配置邮箱，先确认服务器和认证方式，不要把密码发出来。
playbook-setup-email-account.md.prompt_en: Set up my mailbox — confirm the server and auth method first, and never echo the password.
playbook-setup-email-account.md.when_en: User wants to add an email account, set up Mail.app, configure Outlook, or can't receive/send email on their Mac.

playbook-app-doctor.md.detail_zh: 崩溃、打不开、权限和配置损坏
playbook-app-doctor.md.detail_en: Fix app crashes, launch failures, and permission issues
playbook-app-doctor.md.triggers_zh: 应用崩溃、打不开、权限或配置损坏
playbook-app-doctor.md.prompt_zh: 某个 Mac 应用一打开就崩，先收集日志和配置证据。
playbook-app-doctor.md.prompt_en: This Mac app crashes on launch — collect logs and config evidence first.
playbook-app-doctor.md.when_en: User reports: app crashes, app won't open, app frozen, "app is damaged" error, app unexpectedly quit.

playbook-outlook-troubleshooting.md.detail_zh: 同步、卡信、崩溃和配置文件
playbook-outlook-troubleshooting.md.detail_en: Fix Outlook sync failures, crashes, stuck email, and profile corruption
playbook-outlook-troubleshooting.md.triggers_zh: Outlook 同步、崩溃、卡信、配置文件
playbook-outlook-troubleshooting.md.prompt_zh: Outlook 邮件不同步，先判断是网络、账户还是配置文件。
playbook-outlook-troubleshooting.md.prompt_en: Outlook is not syncing — decide whether it is network, account or the profile.
playbook-outlook-troubleshooting.md.when_en: User reports: Outlook won't sync, email stuck in outbox, calendar not updating, Outlook crashes, search not working, "need password" loop, Outlook slow, OST corrupted.

playbook-update-troubleshooting.md.detail_en: Fix stuck macOS updates, failed installations, and software update errors
playbook-update-troubleshooting.md.triggers_zh: macOS 更新卡住、下载或安装失败
playbook-update-troubleshooting.md.prompt_zh: macOS 更新失败，先检查错误原因，不要抹掉系统。
playbook-update-troubleshooting.md.prompt_en: The macOS update failed — find the cause; do not erase the system.
playbook-update-troubleshooting.md.when_en: User reports: macOS update stuck, update won't install, "unable to check for updates" error, update failed, "not enough space" for update, app updates failing.

playbook-windows-update-troubleshooting..detail_zh: 错误码、服务、待重启和更新缓存
playbook-windows-update-troubleshooting..detail_en: Fix stuck Windows Updates, failed installations, and update service errors
playbook-windows-update-troubleshooting..triggers_zh: Windows Update 卡住、错误码、待重启或服务被禁用（只审计/恢复，不提供关闭更新）
playbook-windows-update-troubleshooting..prompt_zh: Windows 更新卡住，先修复更新链路，不要关闭更新。
playbook-windows-update-troubleshooting..prompt_en: Windows Update is stuck — repair the update chain, do not turn updates off.
playbook-windows-update-troubleshooting..when_en: User reports: Windows Update stuck, update won't install, update error code, system slow after update, "something went wrong" during update, pending restart that won't complete.

playbook-printer-repair.md.detail_en: Fix stuck print jobs, missing printers, and CUPS issues
playbook-printer-repair.md.triggers_zh: 打印队列、找不到打印机、CUPS
playbook-printer-repair.md.prompt_zh: Mac 打印队列卡住了，先保留作业内容再处理。
playbook-printer-repair.md.prompt_en: The print queue is stuck on my Mac — preserve the job content before touching it.
playbook-printer-repair.md.when_en: User reports: can't print, print jobs stuck, printer not found, printing fails, printer offline.

playbook-windows-printer-repair.md.detail_zh: 离线状态、打印队列和 Spooler
playbook-windows-printer-repair.md.detail_en: Fix stuck print jobs, offline printers, and spooler issues on Windows
playbook-windows-printer-repair.md.prompt_zh: Windows 打印机离线，清除卡住作业前先告诉我影响。
playbook-windows-printer-repair.md.prompt_en: The Windows printer shows offline — tell me the impact before clearing stuck jobs.
playbook-windows-printer-repair.md.when_en: User reports: can't print, print jobs stuck, printer offline, printer not found, printing fails, "driver is unavailable."

playbook-windows-configuration-review.md.detail_zh: 隐私、电源、去臃肿设置的差异、风险和回滚
playbook-windows-configuration-review.md.detail_en: Review reversible Windows privacy, performance, and usability settings with version gates, diff, and rollback
playbook-windows-configuration-review.md.triggers_zh: Windows 优化、隐私、电源、去臃肿或配置导入
playbook-windows-configuration-review.md.prompt_zh: 审查这份 Windows 优化配置，不要直接套用，给我 diff。
playbook-windows-configuration-review.md.prompt_en: Review this Windows tweaking config — do not apply it, show me the diff.
playbook-windows-configuration-review.md.when_en: Use for “optimize Windows”, debloat, privacy, power-plan, taskbar, update or gaming-tweak requests, and when importing a configuration from another machine.

playbook-windows-uninstall-residue-clean.detail_zh: 严格残留扫描、回收站清理和强制移除审计
playbook-windows-uninstall-residue-clean.detail_en: Preview and clean Windows uninstall residue with strict identity matching and recovery
playbook-windows-uninstall-residue-clean.triggers_zh: 卸载后严格残留扫描、回收站清理和强制移除审计
playbook-windows-uninstall-residue-clean.prompt_zh: 卸载后还有残留，先预览证据和回滚，不要直接强删。
playbook-windows-uninstall-residue-clean.prompt_en: There is residue after uninstall; preview the evidence and rollback before removing anything.
playbook-windows-uninstall-residue-clean.when_en: Use after uninstalling a Windows application when leftover files, registry keys, services or a guarded force-removal review are needed.

playbook-windows-driver-lifecycle-audit..detail_zh: 硬件 ID、官方来源、重装、回滚和兼容性
playbook-windows-driver-lifecycle-audit..detail_en: Diagnose Windows driver failures with hardware IDs, vendor source, reinstall, rollback, and compatibility checks
playbook-windows-driver-lifecycle-audit..triggers_zh: 驱动故障、未知设备、旧设备兼容、驱动回滚
playbook-windows-driver-lifecycle-audit..prompt_zh: 未知 USB 设备找不到驱动，先识别硬件 ID 和官方来源。
playbook-windows-driver-lifecycle-audit..prompt_en: An unknown USB device has no driver — identify the hardware ID and the official source.
playbook-windows-driver-lifecycle-audit..when_en: Use when a Windows device has a yellow warning icon, disappeared after an update, cannot connect, has broken audio/video, or requires an old USB, printer, serial or vendor-specific driver.

playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.title_zh: 摄像头与音视频输入分诊
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.title_en: Windows Audio and Video Input Triage
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.detail_zh: 开关、权限、系统设备和会议软件
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.detail_en: Troubleshoot Windows camera, microphone, headset, and speaker failures across hardware, permissions, drivers, and apps
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.triggers_zh: 摄像头、麦克风、耳机、扬声器或会议软件无法调用
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.prompt_zh: Teams 找不到麦克风，按硬件、权限、驱动、应用四层排查。
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.prompt_en: Teams cannot find my microphone — check hardware, permissions, driver and app in that order.
playbook-windows-av-input-triage.md.when_en: Use when a camera, microphone, headset, speaker or meeting application cannot see, open or select an input/output device.

playbook-windows-boot-failure-triage.md.detail_zh: No Boot Device、启动循环、UEFI/Legacy 和启动界面
playbook-windows-boot-failure-triage.md.detail_en: Triage Windows startup, No Boot Device, UEFI/boot-entry, and pre-login failures without blindly changing firmware
playbook-windows-boot-failure-triage.md.triggers_zh: No Boot Device、启动循环、UEFI/Legacy、异常启动界面
playbook-windows-boot-failure-triage.md.prompt_zh: 开机提示 No Boot Device，不能改 BIOS，先判断磁盘还是启动项。
playbook-windows-boot-failure-triage.md.prompt_en: It says No Boot Device and I cannot change BIOS — is it the disk or the boot entry?
playbook-windows-boot-failure-triage.md.when_en: Use for `No Boot Device`, missing Windows Boot Manager, boot loops, a machine that reaches firmware but not Windows, or a blue pre-login screen that may not be a normal BSOD.

playbook-windows-winre-system-repair.md.detail_zh: SFC、DISM、安全模式、启动修复和还原
playbook-windows-winre-system-repair.md.detail_en: Diagnose Windows startup/system corruption with WinRE, Safe Mode, SFC, DISM, and restore paths
playbook-windows-winre-system-repair.md.triggers_zh: WinRE、系统文件、SFC/DISM、启动修复和还原
playbook-windows-winre-system-repair.md.prompt_zh: Windows 进不了桌面，先做无损修复分诊，不要重装。
playbook-windows-winre-system-repair.md.prompt_en: Windows will not reach the desktop — run non-destructive repair triage, no reinstall.
playbook-windows-winre-system-repair.md.when_en: Use for repeated startup repair, system-file corruption, update-related boot failures, safe-mode requests, damaged Windows components or a machine that cannot reach the desktop reliably.

playbook-windows-bitlocker-recovery-tria.detail_zh: 加密状态、TPM/BIOS、恢复密钥和离线清单
playbook-windows-bitlocker-recovery-tria.detail_en: Audit BitLocker/device encryption before PE, BIOS, hardware, partition, repair, or reinstall operations
playbook-windows-bitlocker-recovery-tria.triggers_zh: 进入 PE、BIOS/TPM、拆机、分区或重装前的 BitLocker 分诊
playbook-windows-bitlocker-recovery-tria.prompt_zh: 我准备进入 PE，请先在当前 Windows 检查 BitLocker 状态；不要输出恢复密钥。
playbook-windows-bitlocker-recovery-tria.prompt_en: I am about to boot into PE — check BitLocker status from the running Windows first; never print the recovery key.
playbook-windows-bitlocker-recovery-tria.when_en: Use before entering PE or Linux, changing BIOS/UEFI or TPM, upgrading firmware, opening a laptop, resizing partitions, reinstalling Windows, moving a disk to another computer, or responding to a BitLocker recovery prompt.

playbook-windows-partition-resize-audit..detail_zh: 邻接空间、备份、移动分区和离线操作边界
playbook-windows-partition-resize-audit..detail_en: Audit Windows partition and C-drive expansion requests with backup, BitLocker, adjacency and offline-tool safety checks
playbook-windows-partition-resize-audit..triggers_zh: C 盘扩容、分区移动、合并空闲空间和重装前磁盘规划
playbook-windows-partition-resize-audit..prompt_zh: C 盘太小，先评估能否安全扩容，不要立即移动分区。
playbook-windows-partition-resize-audit..prompt_en: C: is too small — assess whether it can be safely extended; do not move partitions yet.
playbook-windows-partition-resize-audit..when_en: Use when the user wants to expand C:, shrink or move a data partition, merge free space, change a disk layout or prepare a disk for reinstall.

playbook-windows-hardware-maintenance-sa.detail_zh: 断电放电、ESD、清灰、换件和停工条件
playbook-windows-hardware-maintenance-sa.detail_en: Plan safe Windows laptop hardware maintenance for parts, battery, dust, and thermal work without automatic execution
playbook-windows-hardware-maintenance-sa.triggers_zh: 笔记本换件、断电放电、清灰、硅脂和拆机安全
playbook-windows-hardware-maintenance-sa.prompt_zh: 笔记本发热，先判断是否值得拆机清灰，并列出停工条件。
playbook-windows-hardware-maintenance-sa.prompt_en: The laptop runs hot — decide whether opening it for dust removal is worth it, and list the stop conditions.
playbook-windows-hardware-maintenance-sa.when_en: Use before opening a Windows laptop, replacing storage, memory, wireless cards, battery or display parts, cleaning dust, or renewing thermal compound.

playbook-endpoint-security-check.md.detail_zh: 防病毒、防火墙、更新和可疑活动
playbook-endpoint-security-check.md.detail_en: Quick security posture check — antivirus, firewall, updates, and suspicious activity
playbook-endpoint-security-check.md.triggers_zh: 防病毒、防火墙、更新、可疑活动检查
playbook-endpoint-security-check.md.prompt_zh: 检查系统安全状态，但不要关闭 Defender、防火墙或 UAC。
playbook-endpoint-security-check.md.prompt_en: Check the security posture, but do not disable Defender, the firewall or UAC.
playbook-endpoint-security-check.md.when_en: Routine security audit, post-incident triage, new device onboarding, or user reports suspicious behavior.

playbook-browser-security-audit.md.detail_zh: 扩展、密码存储、版本和安全设置
playbook-browser-security-audit.md.detail_en: Audit browser extensions, saved passwords, and update status for security risks
playbook-browser-security-audit.md.triggers_zh: 浏览器扩展、密码、版本和安全审计
playbook-browser-security-audit.md.prompt_zh: 审计浏览器安全性，不要读取或输出已保存密码。
playbook-browser-security-audit.md.prompt_en: Audit browser security — do not read or print saved passwords.
playbook-browser-security-audit.md.when_en: Routine security review, post-phishing incident, user reports browser behaving strangely, adware/toolbar complaints, or new device onboarding.

playbook-windows-browser-policy-audit.md.detail_en: Audit Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Brave policies without touching profiles or disabling security updates
playbook-windows-browser-policy-audit.md.triggers_zh: Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Brave 策略、遥测和最小化配置
playbook-windows-browser-policy-audit.md.prompt_zh: 检查浏览器策略，不能影响密码、自动更新和企业策略。
playbook-windows-browser-policy-audit.md.prompt_en: Review browser policies without affecting passwords, auto-update or enterprise policy.
playbook-windows-browser-policy-audit.md.when_en: Use when the user wants a minimal browser, less telemetry or sponsored content, suspects policy tampering, or needs to understand a browser configuration file.

playbook-windows-persistence-audit.md.detail_zh: 启动项、服务、计划任务、右键菜单和文件关联
playbook-windows-persistence-audit.md.detail_en: Audit Windows startup, services, scheduled tasks, shell integrations, file associations, and extensions before removal
playbook-windows-persistence-audit.md.triggers_zh: 启动项、服务、计划任务、右键菜单和文件关联残留
playbook-windows-persistence-audit.md.prompt_zh: 查找可疑后台和启动残留，先只读列证据。
playbook-windows-persistence-audit.md.prompt_en: Look for suspicious background and startup leftovers — read-only evidence first.
playbook-windows-persistence-audit.md.when_en: Use for pop-ups, unknown background activity, slow boot, unexplained context-menu items, browser add-ons, file-association hijacks, or a request to remove residual software.

playbook-credential-cleanup.md.detail_zh: SSH key、token、云凭据和事件后残留
playbook-credential-cleanup.md.detail_en: Audit and clean up stored credentials on a device — for offboarding or post-incident response
playbook-credential-cleanup.md.triggers_zh: 离职或事件后的凭据盘点与清理
playbook-credential-cleanup.md.prompt_zh: 我要离职了，先列出需要轮换的凭据，不要把 secret 打印出来。
playbook-credential-cleanup.md.prompt_en: I am leaving the company — list the credentials that need rotating; print no secrets.
playbook-credential-cleanup.md.when_en: Employee offboarding, device being reassigned, compromised credential response, or user wants to clean up old credentials.

playbook-windows-data-recovery-triage.md.detail_zh: 先成像、只读扫描、报告，再写入独立目标
playbook-windows-data-recovery-triage.md.detail_en: Triage deleted or inaccessible Windows data with image-first read-only recovery to a separate target
playbook-windows-data-recovery-triage.md.triggers_zh: 误删、卷不可访问、文件系统损坏、镜像恢复
playbook-windows-data-recovery-triage.md.prompt_zh: 误删文件了，先不要动原硬盘，先规划成像和恢复目标。
playbook-windows-data-recovery-triage.md.prompt_en: I deleted files by accident — do not touch the original disk; plan imaging and a separate recovery target.
playbook-windows-data-recovery-triage.md.when_en: Use for accidental deletion, an inaccessible volume, a damaged filesystem, or a request to recover files from a Windows disk or image.

playbook-setup-homebrew.md.detail_en: Install and configure Homebrew package manager on macOS
playbook-setup-homebrew.md.prompt_zh: 帮我安装 Homebrew，先检查系统版本和现有路径。
playbook-setup-homebrew.md.prompt_en: Install Homebrew — check the OS version and existing paths first.
playbook-setup-homebrew.md.when_en: User wants to install Homebrew, set up a package manager, or says they need to install software on their Mac and doesn't have Homebrew yet.

playbook-setup-cuda.md.detail_en: Install NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit on Linux (Ubuntu/Debian, RHEL/Fedora)
playbook-setup-cuda.md.prompt_zh: 在 Linux 上安装 CUDA，先核对 GPU、驱动和发行版版本。
playbook-setup-cuda.md.prompt_en: Install CUDA on Linux — verify GPU, driver and distro versions first.
playbook-setup-cuda.md.when_en: User wants to install CUDA, set up GPU computing, needs NVIDIA drivers for deep learning/ML, or mentions nvcc/nvidia-smi not found on Linux.

playbook-setup-ssh-key.md.detail_zh: 生成、GitHub 配置和 publickey 排障
playbook-setup-ssh-key.md.detail_en: Generate an SSH key pair and add it to GitHub or another service
playbook-setup-ssh-key.md.prompt_zh: 配置 SSH 连接 GitHub，私钥不要离开本机。
playbook-setup-ssh-key.md.prompt_en: Set up SSH for GitHub; the private key must never leave this machine.
playbook-setup-ssh-key.md.when_en: User wants to set up SSH keys, connect to GitHub via SSH, push to git without password, or says "permission denied (publickey)".

playbook-setup-openclaw.md.detail_en: Install and configure OpenClaw (龙虾), an AI gateway for Claude, WhatsApp, Telegram, and other channels
playbook-setup-openclaw.md.triggers_zh: 安装、引导、网关、渠道和总体验证
playbook-setup-openclaw.md.prompt_zh: 帮我安装 OpenClaw，先检查 Node.js 和端口。
playbook-setup-openclaw.md.prompt_en: Install OpenClaw for me — check Node.js and the ports first.
playbook-setup-openclaw.md.when_en: User wants to install OpenClaw, set up an AI assistant on WhatsApp/Telegram/

playbook-setup-openclaw-install-node.md.detail_zh: 安装或核对 OpenClaw 所需运行时
playbook-setup-openclaw-install-node.md.prompt_zh: OpenClaw 启动不了，先确认 Node.js 版本和来源。
playbook-setup-openclaw-install-node.md.prompt_en: OpenClaw will not start — confirm the Node.js version and where it came from.

playbook-setup-openclaw-configure.md.detail_zh: 模型、渠道、会话和自动化
playbook-setup-openclaw-configure.md.detail_en: Edit OpenClaw configuration — models, channels, sessions, automation
playbook-setup-openclaw-configure.md.triggers_zh: 模型、渠道、会话和自动化配置
playbook-setup-openclaw-configure.md.prompt_zh: 配置 OpenClaw 的模型和会话，密钥只写入本机配置。
playbook-setup-openclaw-configure.md.prompt_en: Configure OpenClaw's model and sessions; write keys only into the local config.

playbook-setup-openclaw-config-reference.detail_zh: 查询配置项和安全默认值
playbook-setup-openclaw-config-reference.triggers_zh: 查询 OpenClaw 配置字段
playbook-setup-openclaw-config-reference.prompt_zh: 这个 OpenClaw 配置字段是什么意思，先给我解释不要修改。
playbook-setup-openclaw-config-reference.prompt_en: What does this OpenClaw config field mean? Explain it, change nothing.

playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu.md.detail_en: Add Feishu (飞书) as a messaging channel for OpenClaw (built-in plugin)
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu.md.triggers_zh: 飞书内置插件，机器人身份
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu.md.prompt_zh: 给 OpenClaw 加飞书机器人，凭据不要出现在聊天记录里。
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu.md.prompt_en: Add a Feishu bot to OpenClaw — credentials must not end up in the chat log.
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu.md.when_en: User wants to connect Feishu/飞书 to OpenClaw, set up a Feishu chatbot,

playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu-offic.detail_en: Add Feishu official plugin (user-identity OAuth — documents, calendar, tasks)
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu-offic.triggers_zh: 飞书官方插件，用户身份与文档能力
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu-offic.prompt_zh: 配置飞书官方插件，先说明权限范围和回滚方法。
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu-offic.prompt_en: Set up the official Feishu plugin — explain the permission scope and rollback first.
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-feishu-offic.when_en: User wants the Feishu official plugin, needs document/calendar/task capabilities

playbook-setup-openclaw-add-telegram.md.detail_en: Add Telegram as a messaging channel for OpenClaw
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-telegram.md.prompt_zh: 给 OpenClaw 接入 Telegram，token 不要显示在输出。
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-telegram.md.prompt_en: Connect Telegram to OpenClaw — do not display the token in the output.

playbook-setup-openclaw-add-whatsapp.md.detail_zh: 登录、重新配置和会话状态
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-whatsapp.md.detail_en: Add or reconfigure WhatsApp for OpenClaw
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-whatsapp.md.prompt_zh: WhatsApp 渠道掉线了，先诊断会话，不要清除现有登录。
playbook-setup-openclaw-add-whatsapp.md.prompt_en: The WhatsApp channel dropped — diagnose the session without clearing the existing login.

playbook-setup-openclaw-china-models.md.detail_en: Set up Chinese AI model providers for OpenClaw (Volcano Engine, Moonshot, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
playbook-setup-openclaw-china-models.md.prompt_zh: 让 OpenClaw 使用 DeepSeek，先比较接口、费用和密钥存放方式。
playbook-setup-openclaw-china-models.md.prompt_en: Make OpenClaw use DeepSeek — compare the API, the cost and where the key is stored.

playbook-setup-openclaw-troubleshooting..detail_en: Diagnose and fix common OpenClaw issues
playbook-setup-openclaw-troubleshooting..triggers_zh: 网关、渠道、模型和日志排错
playbook-setup-openclaw-troubleshooting..prompt_zh: OpenClaw 飞书消息发不出去，先查网关状态和相关日志。
playbook-setup-openclaw-troubleshooting..prompt_en: OpenClaw cannot send Feishu messages — check gateway status and the relevant logs.

playbook-setup-openclaw-uninstall.md.detail_zh: 停止服务、移除配置和验证残留
playbook-setup-openclaw-uninstall.md.detail_en: Completely uninstall OpenClaw — stop services, remove config, uninstall CLI
playbook-setup-openclaw-uninstall.md.prompt_zh: 卸载 OpenClaw，先列出服务、配置和数据目录，确认后再删。
playbook-setup-openclaw-uninstall.md.prompt_en: Uninstall OpenClaw — list services, config and data directories, then delete after I confirm.
playbook-setup-openclaw-uninstall.md.when_en: User wants to uninstall OpenClaw, remove OpenClaw, mentions "openclaw killer",
